eyebrow: The one thing it can't do
code:
Brokerage dashboard shows:

  Storage cost - Azure Blob   $X / month
  Storage cost - AWS S3       $Y / month

What it does NOT change:

  - different APIs
  - different consistency models
  - different IAM models
  - migrating a workload is still hard

A unified chart is not a unified service.
caption: A brokerage layer displays the difference between providers — it doesn't erase it.
